[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility is attributed to Aligned Data Centers. This registry separately lists an Aligned operator record (7 facilities) using the shortened company name; the two are very likely the same company. Aligned own site confirms active operations across North America and Latin America, describing 87 data centers with 6.4 gigawatts of operational and planned capacity spread across 51 campuses, with North America markets including Northern Virginia, Chicago, Dallas, Phoenix, Salt Lake City, Maryland, Ohio, Atlanta, Hillsboro, and Abernathy, Texas. The company emphasizes closed loop cooling, 100 percent renewable energy matching in North America, and recently broke ground on Project Caprock, a 540 megawatt campus in Northwest Texas. No founding date, headquarters, ownership structure, or building specific address and MW figures for this particular row were located in available sourcing this session.
